name: What are common plumbing problems after a bathroom installation?

mainEntity.name: What are common plumbing problems after a bathroom installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common plumbing problems after bathroom installation can include minor leaks around fixtures or pipe connections, slow drains due to improper slope or debris, and issues with water pressure. Occasionally, a toilet may not flush correctly or a shower head may not have adequate flow. These issues often arise from incorrect installation or overlooked details during the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems include leaks, slow drains, water pressure issues, or fixture malfunctions.
